Karatun samfurin lissafi mai sauƙi

Sabuwar cutar Coronavirus (COVID-19), wacce aka haifar da ita ta hanyar cutar numfashi mai tsanani ta coronavirus—2 (SARS-CoV-2), a Afirka tana da bambanci ta hanyar yawan mutane marasa alamun cutar (ko masu alamun cutar kaɗan) waɗanda ake ganin suna taka rawa wajen yaduwar cutar.

Duk da haka, nazarin ya nuna cewa kula da su abu ne mai muhimmanci wajen sarrafa yaduwar SARS-CoV-2.

Mun ƙera samfurin lissafi mai sauƙi na ƙayyadaddun masu kamuwa da cuta-masu kamuwa da cuta-masu kamuwa da cuta-masu warkewa (SEIR) don tantance tasirin keɓewa mai aiki na mutanen da suka kamu da SARS-CoV-2 amma ba su da alamun cutar ta hanyar gwajin lafiyar jama'a don sarrafa barkewar cutar a Lardin Lusaka na Zambiya.

Don bambanci, an fara tantance samfurin ne bisa ga zato cewa mutanen da ba su da alamun cutar suna da kumburi iri ɗaya da waɗanda ke da alamun cutar, sannan kuma na biyu, kuma mafi yuwuwar, ana zato mutanen da ba su da alamun cutar rabin kumburi ne kawai kamar waɗanda ke da alamun cutar.

Saboda halayen COVID-19 sun yi kama da bambanta daga wuri zuwa wuri, sun bincika yanayi guda 4, inda ko kashi 50% ko 70% na masu kamuwa da COVID-19 ba su da alamun cutar, kuma wadannan lokuta ko dai sun yi daidai ko rabi kamar yadda masu alamun cutar ke yaduwa.

Ko da Zambia ta sanya matakan hana yaduwar COVID-19 da yawa, amma har yanzu ya yi kama da yawan masu kamuwa da cutar na ƙaruwa.
Gwajin kowa ya rage yawan cutar COVID-19 da kashi 90% a ƙaramar ƙauye a Italiya.
Amma, babu bincike na baya da ke nuna zai yi tasiri a babbar birni a wani wuri.
Lura cewa masu binciken ba su yi gwajin duka ba a wannan binciken; maimakon haka, sun ƙirƙiri samfurin da ke nuna cewa gwajin duka zai yi aiki wajen iyakance yaduwar COVID-19 a manyan birane.
Amma, sun yi gargadi da cewa zai iya zama mai tsada sosai.
Sun kuma ce hakan na iya zama da amfani sosai idan aka haɗa shi da wasu matakan, kamar rufe gari, bin diddigin mutanen da suka yi hulɗa da marasa lafiya, da kuma allurar riga-kafin.
Masu bincike na Zambiya sun kuma jaddada cewa, a lokacin, alamun cutar COVID-19 marasa alama sun fi yawa a Afirka.
Rashin iya amfani da maki na polygenic a yawancin al'ummomin Afirka saboda bambancin halittu da na muhalli.
Al'ummun Afirka ba su da wakilci sosai a cikin nazarin kwayoyin halitta amma suna da bambancin kwayoyin halitta mafi yawa kuma suna fuskantar tasirin muhalli daban-daban a duniya.

Domin ba a gudanar da bincike na tsarin hasashen kwayoyin halitta ba a cikin kabilu masu bambancin Afirka, mun ƙididdige maki na haɗarin kwayoyin halitta da yawa (PRS) a cikin kwaikwayo a Afirka da kuma a cikin bayanai na ainihi daga Afirka ta Kudu, Uganda, da Birtaniya don fahimtar yadda za a iya amfani da binciken kwayoyin halitta.
Daidaito na PRS ya inganta tare da ƙungiyoyin bincike masu dacewa da asalin zuriya fiye da karatun da ba su dace da asalin zuriya ba.
A tsakanin 'yan Afirka ta Kudu masu asali da kabilu daban-daban, mun gano cewa daidaito na PRS yana da ƙasa ga dukkan halaye amma ya bambanta a tsakanin ƙungiyoyi.
Bambancin asalin Afirka ya fi bayar da gudunmawa ga bambancin daidaito na PRS fiye da sauran bambance-bambancen manyan ƙungiyoyi da aka yi la'akari da su tsakanin mutane a Burtaniya da Uganda.

Mun ƙididdige PRS a cikin al’ummomin da ke da asalin Afirka ta amfani da nazarin ilimin halittar jini na Turai kawai idan aka kwatanta da na asali iri-iri; ƙaruwar bambancin ya haifar da manyan ci gaba a cikin daidaito ga ƙarfin hemoglobin da adadin ƙwayoyin jinin farare, yana nuna bambance-bambancen da ke da tasiri mai yawa a cikin jinsunan da aka sani suna shafar cutar sikil sel da kuma amsawar rashin lafiyar, bi da bi.
Bambancin daidaito na PRS tsakanin kabilun Afirka da suka fito daga yankuna daban-daban, ya yi yawa kamar bambancin da ke tsakanin kabilun da ba na Afirka ba, wanda ke buƙatar ƙarin fahimta.
Me yasa ba za mu iya yin hasashen cututtukan kwayoyin halitta daidai ba ga mutanen da suka fito daga Afirka?
Masu bincike sun ce hanyoyin da ake amfani da su yanzu wajen hasashen ko mutum zai kamu da cutar kwayoyin halitta ko a'a ba sa aiki sosai ga mutanen asalin Afirka.
Wannan shi ne saboda bayanai da ke bayan irin wannan hasashen galibi sun bayyana  jinunan mutanen asalin Turai.
Cibiyar bayanai ta GWAS tana nufin “Nazari kan Haɗin Kai na Ƙwayoyin Halitta a Faɗin Jiki”, kuma masana kimiyya suna amfani da ita wajen binciken halaye da cututtuka dangane da ƙwayoyin halitta.
Lallai, za su iya amfani da GWAS don ƙididdige haɗarin cutar ko halayyar wani mutum ta hanyar kwayoyin halitta.

A wannan bincike, masu bincike sun so su ga yadda lissafin da suke amfani da shi wajen tantance haɗarin cututtukan kwayoyin halitta ta amfani da GWAS ke aiki ga mutanen da suka fito daga kabilar Afirka.

Ana san lissafin a matsayin “ƙimar haɗarin polygenic”, ko PRS, a fannoni masu zurfi na kimiyya.

Sun yi amfani da kwamfutoci wajen ƙididdige haɗarin kwayoyin halitta da aka yi hasashen al'ummar Afirka ta amfani da GWAS, kuma sun yi amfani da rikodin likitoci na mutanen Afirka don duban wasu halaye ko cututtuka da suka iya faruwa sakamakon canje-canje a cikin kwayoyin halitta.
Lokacin da suka yi amfani da GWAS na Turai, sun gano cewa ƙimar haɗarin kwayoyin halitta ta fi daidaito idan mutane suna da asalin Turai idan aka kwatanta da asalin Afirka ga yawancin halaye.
Sun ce maki na haɗari sun yi ƙasa sosai tsakanin yankunan Afirka saboda akwai bambancin jama'a sosai, wanda bai dace da abin da muke gani ga asalin Turai ba.
Sun kuma ce daidaito na PRS yana ƙaruwa yayin da asalin Afirka ke raguwa.
Al'ummar Habasha sun sami hasashen cututtukan kwayoyin halitta mafi kyau saboda suna kama da al'ummar Turai a bangaren kwayoyin halitta.
Lokacin amfani da GWAS mai bambancin iri-iri wanda ya haɗa da mutanen da suka fito daga Afirka, daidaito na hasashen ya inganta.
Hasashen cututtukan jini ya fi daidaito musamman.
Binciken da suka gabata sun nuna cewa PRS yana da ƙasa ga al'ummomin Afirka, ma'ana cewa tushen bayanai na GWAS yana hasashen ƙarancin haɗarin cututtukan kwayoyin halitta ga mutanen asalin Afirka.
Amma mun sani cewa ba lallai ba ne haka.

Wannan binciken ya bayyana cewa wannan ƙarancin ƙimar haɗarin cututtukan kwayoyin halitta saboda ba a samu wakilcin kwayoyin halittar Afirka sosai ba a cikin tushen bayanai na GWAS, don haka ƙimar PRS na yanzu ba za ta taimaka wajen hasashen cututtukan kwayoyin halitta a Afirka ba.
Masu bincike sun ce zai fi kyau a yi amfani da tushen bayanai mai bambancin iri wanda ya haɗa da bayanan halittar mutanen Afirka.
Don haka, ana buƙatar ƙarin aiki don bambanta GWAS don haɗa asalin Afirka don haka za mu iya hasashen haɗarin cututtukan kwayoyin halitta a cikin al'ummomin Afirka daidai.
Marubutan wannan binciken sun fito daga Afirka, Amurka da Birtaniya.
Binciken Ganewa da Na Kwayoyin Halitta a Rigakafin Ciwon Nama Na Ciki da Ciwon Da ke Shafar Ciki a Namibia
An kiyasta mata dubu 851 da dari 340 a Namibia suna cikin haɗarin kamuwa da cutar kwayar cutar human papilloma virus (HPV) wanda zai iya haifar da cutar kansa ta mahaifa.
An tabbatar da gwajin gani da acid acetic (VIA) da kuma maganin sanyi suna da tasiri sosai.
Amma, bayanai masu alaƙa da tasirin shirye-shiryen gwajin cutar kankarin mahaifa ba su da yawa.
Wannan binciken ya tantance gwajin gani da na kwayoyin halitta wajen hana cututtukan da ke shafar saman mahaifa (CIN) da cutar kansa ta mahaifa a Namibia.
Sakamakon ya nuna cewa mata masu kamuwa da cutar HPV,  cervicitis, koilocytosis da atypia suna da haɗarin kamuwa da gwajin VIA mai kyau.
Mata masu shekaru, musamman waɗanda ke dauke da cutar HIV, suna da yuwuwar kamuwa da cutar kansa ta squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).

Hanyar VIA ta yi kama da ta dace wajen gwaji, duk da haka ya kamata a sake duba amfani da colposcopy a bin diddigin marasa lafiya a yanayin Namibia, a kuma yi amfani da ita ne kawai idan sakamakon gwajin HR-HPV ya tabbata.
Ana bada shawara a yi amfani da hanyoyin gwaji da suka haɗa da gwajin HPV ga daban-daban shekaru da kuma rukunin mutane masu haɗari (misali, masu kamuwa da cutar HIV, masu cutar autoimmune).

Za a iya inganta karɓar gwajin ne ta hanyar shirye-shiryen da suka ɗauki samfurin da ke amfani da sakamakon ganewar asali, manufofin kiwon lafiyar mata, ilimi da aiki na zamani masu dacewa da yanayin ƙasa.
Ya kamata a gwada mata Namibiyawa da ke cikin haɗarin kamuwa da cutar kansa ta mahaifa a wuri-wuri kuma a yi musu magani da wuri.
Gwaje-gwaje da yawa za su iya nuna haɗarin cutar kankarin mahaifa ga mata, amma duban lafiya na yau da kullun a Namibia ba koyaushe suke amfani da waɗannan gwaje-gwajen ba.
Masu bincike sun ba da shawarar gwaji na yau da kullun, don gano alamomin gargaɗi a da wuri, hakan zai iya hana mata kamuwa da wannan cuta mai hatsari.
Ciwon da ke shafar mahaifa (ciwon da ke shafar sashen ƙasa na mahaifa) yana haddasa mutuwar mata da yawa a duniya.
Daya daga cikin manyan abubuwan da ke haifar da cutar kankarin mahaifa shine kwayar cutar Human Papillomavirus, ko kuma HPV.
HPV ƙwayar cuta ce da ke lalata kwayoyin halittar mahaifa, ta samar da raunuka da ake kira lesions, waɗanda daga baya zasu iya zama cutar kansa.
Ko da akwai allurar riga-kafi don hana HPV, mata da yawa a ƙasashen Afirka, ciki har da Namibiya, ba su da damar samun ta.
Wannan yana nufin cewa binciken cutar ko raunukan da take haifarwa abu ne mai matukar muhimmanci ga wadannan mata, domin shi ne hanya mafi kyau ta taimaka wajen hana ciwon daji.
Masu binciken a wannan nazari sun ce a saboda haka, asibitoci suna buƙatar jagorori da bayanai masu kyau game da gwaje-gwajen da suka fi dacewa da amfani.
Sun ƙara da cewa ma'aikatan lafiya kuma suna buƙatar ƙarin bayani game da yadda abubuwa kamar shekaru ko lafiya ke shafar haɗarin mace na kamuwa da cutar HPV da kansa.
Sun bincika yadda wasu nau’o’in gwaje-gwaje na gama gari (wanda ake kira hanyoyin gwaji) suka yi tasiri wajen gano HPV da raunuka.
Sun kuma sha'awar kwatanta hanyoyin gwaji, alal misali tattara ƙwayoyin halitta daga mahaifa don bincika lalacewa idan aka kwatanta da kawai neman raunuka.
Sun kuma so sanin ko bambance-bambance tsakanin mata, kamar shekarunsu, ko kuma ko suna da wasu cututtuka kamar HIV, sun canza damar samun HPV da kansar.
Sanin wannan bayanin zai iya taimaka wa asibitoci da cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya wajen amfani da hanyoyin gwaji yadda ya kamata.
Masu binciken sun duba rikodin marasa lafiya mata 214 da aka gwada kuma aka yi musu magani game da HPV, raunuka, da cutar kansa ta mahaifa a asibiti a Windhoek, Namibiya.
Sun mayar da hankali musamman kan ciwon da ke shafar mahaifa a farkon mataki, wanda shine lokacin da za a iya magance cutar cikin sauƙi da inganci.
Sun kuma tattara bayanan game da shekarun kowace mace, da kuma lafiyar ta gaba ɗaya.

Da suka bincika waɗannan rikodin, sun gano cewa hanyoyin gwaji daban-daban akai-akai suna baiwa ma'aikatan lafiya bayanai daban-daban, kuma zasu iya zama masu amfani kafin ko bayan HPV ya zama ciwon daji.
Alal misali, a kan samu cutar kansa ta hanyar tattara da bincika ƙwayoyin mahaifa.
Duk da haka, a sau da yawa ana iya ganin raunuka ne kawai ta hanyar dubawa da ido, ta amfani da dabarar da ake kira "dubawa da ido tare da acetic acid" (VIA).
Amfanin wannan fasaha shi ne, yana ba likitoci damar gano raunuka cikin sauri kuma a kan farashi mai sauƙi.

Wannan shi ne saboda yana amfani da kayan aikin likita na yau da kullun da aka riga aka yi amfani da su wajen binciken mata, kamar na gani a cikin farji (ƙarfe da ake amfani da shi wajen kallon cikin farji).
Sun kuma gano cewa haɗa hanyoyi daban-daban sau da yawa yana ba likitoci ƙarin bayani game da haɗarin mace na kamuwa da cutar kansa, musamman a lokacin dubawa da dama.
Bugu da ƙari, masu binciken sun gano cewa mata masu tsufa, musamman waɗanda ke da cutar HIV, suna da yuwuwar kamuwa da cutar kansa, don haka gwada su akai-akai na iya zama da muhimmanci musamman.

Yin hakan na iya zama hanya mai muhimmanci ta gano cutar da wuri.

A ƙarshe, sun ce sakamakon bincikensu ya nuna akwai buƙatar tsarin kiwon lafiya a Namibia ya tsara dabarun rigakafin cutar HPV da cutar kansa ta mahaifa yadda ya kamata, ta amfani da hanyoyin gwaji masu arha da inganci don gano waɗannan cututtuka a matakin farko.
Nazarin hadin gwiwa ne tsakanin masana kimiyya daga Namibiya da Afirka ta Kudu.
Amfanin magani a cutar HBV/HIV idan aka kwatanta da cutar HBV kaɗai a ƙungiyar marasa lafiya ta Afirka ta Kudu.

Bisa ga manufofin kasa da kasa na kawar da cutar sankarau ta hanta B (HBV), mun fara nazarin mutanen da ke dauke da cutar HBV kadai, idan aka kwatanta da wadanda ke dauke da cutar HBV/HIV tare, domin tantance tasirin magani da kuma jagorantar ingantaccen kulawa ta likita.
Mun gabatar da bayanai daga binciken ainihin duniya na ƙungiyar marasa lafiya 115 manya masu kamuwa da cutar hanta ta B na kullum (CHB), a asibiti na jami’a a Cape Town, Afirka ta Kudu.
Cututtukan HIV tare sun kasance a jikin mutane 39 (kashi 34%).
Mun rubuta bayanai masu yawa na yawan jama'a, asibiti da na dakin gwaje-gwaje.

Idan aka kwatanta da waɗanda ke da cutar HIV tare da cutar HBV, manya masu kamuwa da cutar HBV kaɗai ba su da yiwuwar samun HBeAg-positive (p=0.01), ba su da yiwuwar yin gwaji da elastography (p<0.0001), kuma ba su da yiwuwar samun magani na antiviral (p<0.0001); sun fi yiwuwar samun HBV viraemia da za a iya gano (p=0.04), kuma sun fi yiwuwar samun alamun cutar hanta, ciki har da thrombocytopaenia matsakaici/mai tsanani (p=0.007), bilirubin mai yawa (p=0.004), da kuma ƙimar APRI mai yawa (p=0.02).
Hanyoyin cutar kansa na hanta guda uku dukkansu sun fito ne daga kamuwa da cutar HBV kadai.

Bayananmu sun nuna cewa mutanen da ke dauke da cutar HBV kaɗai na iya samun rashin daidaito idan aka kwatanta da waɗanda ke da cutar HIV tare, wanda ke haskaka yiwuwar rashin daidaito na tsarin aikin tuntuɓe, sa ido da kuma magani.
Masu bincike sun bayar da jagorori don inganta maganin cutar hanta ta B.

A cikin wani bincike na kwanan nan, masu bincike sun iya haskaka yadda kamuwa da cutar hanta ta B (HBV) da kuma cutar immunodeficiency ta ɗan adam (HIV) na iya ba da fa'ida ta magani fiye da kamuwa da HBV kadai.
A kudancin Afirka, kamuwa da cutar hanta ta HBV da kuma cutar HIV na tsawon lokaci babbar matsala ce.
Likitoci suna buƙatar fahimtar yadda waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta da magungunan da ake amfani da su wajen maganinsu ke hulɗa da juna, don su iya yin ganewar asali da kula da marasa lafiya sosai.

Domin wannan bincike, masu binciken sun dauki marasa lafiya manya 115 da ke dauke da cutar hanta ta B na kullum (CHB).
An dauke su daga asibiti Tygerberg a birnin Cape Town, Afirka ta Kudu.
Wasu marasa lafiya sun kamu da cutar HIV (39) sauran kuma sun kamu da cutar HBV kawai.
Masu bincike sun kalli kabila, shekaru da jima'i, sannan suka gudanar da gwaje-gwajen asibiti da na dakin gwaje-gwaje daban-daban.

Sun gano cewa marasa lafiya da ke dauke da HBV kawai, ba su da yuwuwar samun magani na rigakafin cututtukan kwayar cuta, suna nuna alamun cutar hanta ta halitta (tun da HBV kwayar cuta ce da ke iya haifar da mummunan cutar hanta).

Masu binciken sun iya nuna cewa mutanen da ke dauke da HBV kawai suna da rashin nasara idan aka kwatanta da wadanda ke dauke da HIV da HBV duka, domin marasa lafiya da suka kamu da kwayoyin cutar biyu suna iya samun maganin rigakafin HIV, wanda kuma yana da amfani wajen yakar kamuwa da cutar HBV.

Sakamakon wannan bincike ya haskaka yuwuwar tasirin bambance-bambancen tsakanin hanyoyin tura marasa lafiya, kula da su, da kuma maganin cutar hanta ta HBV idan aka kwatanta da cutar HIV da kuma hadin cutar HBV, wanda ya fi amfana ga wadanda suka kamu da cutar HIV da HBV duka biyu.
Masu binciken sun jaddada cewa dole ne mu inganta kuma mu samar da sabis mai aminci da adalci ga marasa lafiya da ke dauke da cutar HBV kawai.
Gurguzu ɗaya na wannan bincike shine ƙarancin yawan jama'a da aka mayar da hankali a kan ƙasa ɗaya da tsarin asibitoci na ƙasar kawai.
Wasu, watakila ma'aikatun asibiti masu ci gaba, na iya nuna ra'ayi daban idan aka kwatanta da abin da aka samu a wannan binciken.
Za a buƙaci yin ƙarin bincike don gano bambance-bambancen da aka samu a wannan binciken a zahiri.
Wannan takarda ta nuna ƙarfin hadin kai, inda masu bincike daga Afirka ta Kudu da Birtaniya suka yi aiki tare a wannan aikin.
Da aka yi amfani da marasa lafiya na Afirka ta Kudu a wannan bincike, yana da muhimmanci ga wani ɓangare na al'ummar Afirka.
Bugu da ƙari, binciken na iya taimakawa wajen samar da ingantattun tsare-tsaren magani ga waɗanda ke fama da HBV, HIV ko duka biyu.
Kimanta Tasiririn Rashin Tsaro akan Ayyukan Kasuwancin Mata a Karamar Hukumar SHIRORO ta Jihar Neja

Wannan binciken ya bincika tasirin rashin tsaro kan ayyukan kasuwancin mata a Karamar Hukumar Shiroro ta Jihar Neja, inda ya mayar da hankali musamman kan batutuwan dogaro da kuɗin mata, irin ayyukan kasuwanci da suka zama ruwan dare tsakaninsu da kuma girman tasirin rashin tsaro kan ƙoƙarin kasuwancinsu.

An yi bincike ga samfurin mata 377, wanda ya haifar da bincike da ya nuna cewa mata a Shiroro suna da kishin kasuwanci sosai tare da matsayin ‘yancin kai na kudi mai girma, suna yin kasuwanci kanana da matsakaici.

Binciken ya kuma gano cewa yayin da rashin tsaro ke da mummunan tasiri ga ayyukan kasuwancin mata a matsayin asarar ko raguwar jari da sauran abubuwa, adadin mata masu kasuwanci bai samu raguwa mai yawa ba.

Nazarin ya bada shawara da a kirkiro shirye-shiryen dorewa domin inganta samun mata da amfani da ayyukan kudi, kuma ya kamata a kirkiro da kuma ƙarfafa kungiyoyin ‘yan sanda na al’umma domin yakar rashin tsaro a yankin da aka gudanar da binciken.
'Yan kasuwa mata a Nijar na bukatar ƙarin tsaro.
Masu bincike sun gano cewa mata masu kasuwanci a Nijar suna da ƙwazo sosai kuma suna da ‘yancin kai ta fuskar kuɗi, amma aminci daga masu laifi matsala ce.
Masu bincike sun so sanin matakin aminci da tsaro na mata masu kasuwanci a Karamar Hukumar Shiroro ta Jihar Neja, da kuma yadda hakan zai iya shafar kasuwancinsu da kuma ‘yancin tattalin arzikinsu.
Sun yi hira da mata 377 a wannan yankin game da kalubalen da suke fuskanta dangane da ayyukan kasuwancinsu, dogaro da kuɗi da rashin tsaro.
Sun ruwaito cewa kashi 43% na matan sun ce ba sa dogaro da maza don kuɗi, kuma kashi 32% sun ce akwai wasu mutane da ke dogaro da su don kuɗi.
Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa kashi 85% na matan suna samun kuɗi daga kasuwanci daban-daban, kuma kaɗan ne kawai suka ce sun dogara da albashi.
Kimanin kashi 56% sun samu kuɗi ta hanyar noma, kuma kashi 79% ta hanyar ciniki.
Kimanin mace 1 daga cikin mata 5 ta samu kuɗi ta hanyar ɗaure gashi, yin sawa, saka, ko yin wanke-wanke.
Yawancin mata (91%) sun shaida wa masu bincike cewa harkokinsu sun shafa sakamakon tsoron kai hare-hare daga masu satar kaya da miyagu.
Sun rasa kuɗi, har ma da mazajensu saboda waɗannan hare-haren, wanda hakan yana tilasta musu kula da 'ya'yansu su kaɗai.
Matan kuma sun ce basu da isassun ƙwarewa da kuɗi don fadada kasuwancinsu.
Masu binciken sun rahoto cewa duk da kalubalen, mata a Nijar sun ci gaba da yin nasara sosai a harkokinsu.
Sun ce Shiroro na da mutane daga kabilu da addinai daban-daban, kuma wannan yana da kyau ga kasuwanci.
Wannan binciken yana ƙalubalantar binciken masu bincike da suka gabata waɗanda suka bayar da rahoton cewa mata ba sa samun nasara a kasuwanci saboda kula da gidajensu.
Amma, waɗannan masu bincike sun ce nasarar mata 'yan kasuwa a wannan yankin Nijar ta fi shafawa ta hanyar barazanar hare-haren masu laifi da masu sata.
Masu binciken sun ba da shawarar cewa duk masu ruwa da tsaki ya kamata su haɗu su yi yaƙi da abubuwan da za su iya sa samun nasara a kasuwanci ya zama wuya.
Alal misali, ya kamata mata a Nijar su samu damar samun kuɗi, gonaki da kuma tsaro.
Sun kuma bayar da shawara cewa mata masu kasuwanci za su iya kafa kungiyoyi da za su taimaka musu wajen yakar masu satar da miyagu.
Matakan Selenium, Tagulla da Zinc a Jinin Uwa a Lokacin Daukar Ciki Sun Shafi Hadarin Haihuwar Haihuwa Ba Da Lokaci Ba: Nazarin Case-Control Daga Malawi
Haihuwar da wuri ita ce haihuwar da ta gabata makonni 37 da suka cika.
An gudanar da bincike domin tantance alaƙar matakan sinadarin selenium, tagulla, da zinc a jinin uwa da haihuwar ɓata lokaci.
Akwai mata 181 a wannan binciken na nazari na shari’a da iko, 90/181 (49.7%) cikakkun lokaci da 91/181 (50.3%) mata masu juna biyu da ba a cikakken lokaci ba.

Matsakaicin matsakaicin maidaurin sinadarin selenium a jini shine 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, jan karfe shine 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L kuma zinc shine 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L tare da ƙimar da aka ambata ta 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L da 0.59-1.11 mg/L, bi da bi.
Sakamakon ya nuna babu karancin selenium da zinc; kuma akwai yawan sinadarin jan karfe a jinin mata masu ciki.
Haihuwar da ta yi wuri ta shafi ƙaruwar sinadarin jan karfe da zinci a jinin uwa.
Matakan Zinc, tagulla, da selenium da suka shafi haihuwar da wuri

Masu bincike sun gano yawan sinadarai masu mahimmanci kamar selenium, tagulla, da zinc, a jikin mata da suka yi haihuwa kafin lokaci, amma har yanzu ba su san ko wannan yawan ya fito ne daga abincin da suke ci ba.
Haihuwar da ta yi wuri tana faruwa ne lokacin da mace ta haifi ɗa kafin ta cika makonni 37 na daukar ciki.
Haihuwar da ta yi wuri tana da alaƙa da sakamakon lafiya mara kyau ga jariri, daga nakasu har zuwa mutuwa.
Akwai dalilai da dama da ke haifar da haihuwar jarirai kafin lokaci, amma rawar da yawan sinadarai masu mahimmanci da ake samu a abinci da muhalli ke takawa ba a san shi sosai ba.
Waɗannan ƙananan abinci masu gina jiki suna da muhimmanci ga ci gaban jariri, amma masu bincike suna son sanin abin da ke faruwa idan sun yi yawa.

A wannan bincike, masu bincike sun yi niyyar auna yawan selenium, tagulla, da zinc a jikin mata da suka yi haihuwa kafin lokaci, sannan su tantance yiwuwar haihuwar da aka yi kafin lokaci ta hanyar yawan kowane sinadarin abinci mai gina jiki da aka yi nazari a kai.
Masu binciken sun tattara samfurin jinin mata 181 nan da nan bayan sun haifa a asibitoci biyu a Lilongwe, babban birnin Malawi, tsakanin watan Yunin 2016 da Maris 2017.
Sun aika samfuran jinin zuwa dakin gwaje-gwaje a Norway inda suka fitar da sinadarin jini, wanda shi ne nau’in jini mai tsafta, sannan suka auna yawan selenium, tagulla da zinc.
Kimanin rabin mata 181 da aka yi nazari a kansu sun haihu kafin lokaci, kuma masu bincike sun gano yawan sinadarin selenium, tagulla da zinc sosai.

Sai suka daidaita lissafin su domin su ƙara la’akari da sauran abubuwa da dama kamar shekaru, lafiyar jiki gaba ɗaya, da tarihin daukar ciki domin su iya gano tasirin da ake zargin sinadarai masu ƙarfi suke yi wajen haifar da haihuwar da wuri.

Sun ƙarasa da cewa yawan sinadarin selenium da jan karfe ba su taka rawa mai muhimmanci ba wajen haifar da haihuwar da wuri, amma yawan sinadarin zinc ya ƙara haɗarin haihuwar da wuri sau shida fiye da haka.
Duk da haka, yawan jan karfe da yawa ya zama abin damuwa ga masu bincike, saboda illolin da aka sani.

Kasancewar mata 181 ne kawai suka shiga binciken ya iyakance damar masu binciken wajen gano haɗarin da ke tattare da matakan selenium mai yawa yadda ya kamata, domin yawan masu shiga da ya dace shine 600.
Ba a bincika abincin yau da kullun na mahalarta ba don nemo yuwuwar tushen sinadarai guda uku masu ƙarfi, kuma ba a rubuta BMI (Body Mass Index) na jikinsu ba.
Wannan shi ne binciken farko na irin sa da ya auna tasirin selenium, tagulla da zinc a mata masu juna biyu a Malawi.

Afirka na da wasu daga cikin mafi girman matakan haihuwar jarirai kafin lokaci - sama da kashi 18% idan aka kwatanta da ƙasashen Yammacin Turai da ke da kashi 5%, don haka masu bincike suna son sanin ko abinci mai gina jiki yana da rawa.
Halin Komawa Gida, Amincewa da Wuri, da Yankin Mulki na Kazar Kura (Malacochersus tornieri) a Kenya
Dabbobi suna nuna halaye na musamman na sarari da lokaci waɗanda ke ƙara yawan rayuwarsu.
Gane irin waɗannan halayya mataki ne mai muhimmanci wajen ingantaccen kiyayewa da gudanarwa musamman na nau'ikan da ke cikin haɗari.

A wannan bincike, mun gwada ko kurmi na Pancake yana da ikon komawa gida idan aka canza wurinsa, kuma mun bincika amincin wurin da kuma yankin da wannan nau'in yake zaune a halittunsa na halitta a gundumar Kitui, Kenya.

An yi nazari kan halayyar kwaɗayen ƙasa 39 da ke zaune a cikin ramuka masu faɗaɗa dutse 12 da ke faɗaɗa wurare daban-daban daga watan Yuli 2020 zuwa Yuni 2022 ta hanyar bin diddigin rediyo, kama da kyamara da haɗa samfurin binciken ƙungiya da kuma samfurin ad libitum.

An saka na'urar watsa radiyo a kan kwatangwalo goma sha huɗu, an kuma mayar da su daga ramuka dabam-dabam na gidajensu zuwa wasu ramuka masu nisa daga gidajensu, sannan kuma aka bibiyi motsinsu da halayensu.

Banda mata biyu kawai da suka dace sosai da sabbin ramuka da aka mayar da su, sauran kuraje duk sun ƙoƙarta dawowa gidajensu, inda kashi 46.15% daga cikinsu suka gano hanyarsu ta komawa rumfunansu na gida daidai gwargwado, kuma kashi 15.38% kuma sun isa wurare da ake ganin suna cikin yankin gidajensu.
Nasarar dawowar gida ba shakka tana nuna amincin wurin zama sosai a wannan nau'in halitta.

Binciken da aka yi game da yawan ƙwaƙƙwaran ƙwai a cikin ramuka ya nuna cewa babu bambanci mai ma'ana a fannin kididdiga tsakanin adadin ƙwaƙƙwaran da suka fara samuwa a cikin ramuka da matsakaicin adadin da suka kasance a cikin kwanaki 162 na samfurori (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P > 0.05), wanda hakan ya ƙara tabbatar da amincin wuri a cikin nau'in.

A gefe guda kuma,  abin da aka gani ta hanyar kama dabbobi da kyamara da kuma  samfurin  ad libitum sun kuma tabbatar da cewa kurma na Pancake suna da yankinsu kuma maza suna kare yankunansu da ƙarfi daga sauran mazan da ke shigowa.
Kunkuru masu kewayawa da suka ɓace suna da basirar ban mamaki ta ‘samun gida’.

Masu bincike sun samu abin mamaki yayin da suke nazari kan halayyar kurmi masu  ƙafafuwa na Gabashin Afirka (Malacochersus tornieri): dabbobi na iya samun hanyarsu ta koma gida bayan an motsa su a nesa.
Fahimtar yadda da dalilin da suke yin hakan na iya zama muhimmi ga kiyaye waɗannan kwaroron masu rarrafe masu rareness.
Hanyoyin nemo gida da waɗannan zakuna ke nunawa ana kiransa “nemo gida”, kuma sauran dabbobi da yawa ma suna iya yin hakan.
Yiwuwar komawa wurare na musamman yana ba da damar dabbobi su dawo ga abinci, abokan aure, da mafaka, wanda hakan ke inganta damar rayuwarsu da kuma haihuwa.

Ko da yake an yi nazarin halayyar dawowa gida a cikin kunkuru na teku da na ruwan sha, masu binciken a wannan binciken sun ce har yanzu ba mu san da yawa ba game da dawowa gida a cikin kurmi (na ƙasa iri ɗaya da kunkuru).
A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su fahimci halayen zakaran kasko a mazauninsu na halitta a tsaunukan dutse na Kenya.
Sun yi nazari kan dabbobi yayin da suke motsawa da ci, kuma lokacin da suka je hutawa a ramuka, ko kuma gibba a cikin dutse.
Masu binciken sun lura da rukunin kunkuru masu faffadan baya na kusan shekaru biyu, kuma sun sanya kyamarori don yin rikodin bidiyon dabbobi lokacin da ba su kallonsu ba.
Sun kuma ɗaura na'urorin watsa rediyo a kan kurmi 14.
Wadannan na’urori ne ƙanana waɗanda ke ba masu bincike damar bibiyar motsin dabbobi, da kuma sa ido kan inda suke kashe lokacinsu a rana da dare.
Sannan masu binciken suka ɗauki wasu daga cikin kurajen da aka bibiyi zuwa wata sabuwar kasa, domin su iya nazari a kansu cikin sauƙi.
Amma abin mamaki ga masu binciken, biyu daga cikin zakuna suka fara komawa yankunansu na asali, tsakanin kilomita 1 zuwa 2.5 daga inda aka mayar da su.
Wannan shine lokacin da masu binciken suka yanke shawarar gwada motsa ƙarin dabbobi daga gidajensu, don ganin ko za su nuna irin wannan halayyar ‘dawowa gida’.
Abin mamaki, kusan rabin kunkuru sun iya samun hanyarsu zuwa ga irin waɗannan ramuka da suka zauna a ciki kafin a motsa su, sau da yawa suna tafiya sama da kilomita 1.5 don zuwa can.
Wasu kashi 15% kuma sun iya dawowa yankin, amma ba su iya samun rami da aka ɗauke su daga ciki ba.
Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa ramuka daban-daban yawanci suna da adadin kurame iri ɗaya da ke hutawa a cikinsu, wanda ke nuna cewa kuramen yawanci suna amfani da wurare iri ɗaya don hutawa.
Hotunan da aka dauka daga kyamarori sun kuma nuna cewa zakuna masu namiji suna da yankinsu, ma’ana zasu yi fada da wasu mazaje da ke kokarin shiga yankinsu ko kuma rami.

Masu binciken sun ce wannan shi ne karon farko da aka ga halayyar komawa gida a cikin kunkuru masu faffada, kuma sakamakon bincikensu ya nuna cewa waɗannan dabbobi suna son zama da hutawa a wurare ɗaya duk lokacin da za su iya.
Binciken nasu bai bayyana yadda zakuna ke samun hanyarsu ta gida ba, don haka bincike na gaba ya kamata ya mayar da hankali kan fahimtar wannan muhimmiyar magana.
Domin a wasu lokutan ana buƙatar motsa dabbobi zuwa sabbin wurare domin kare su, wannan bayanin zai taimaka wa masu kare muhalli wajen kiyaye kunkuru lafiya a sabon muhalli.
Nazarin haɗin gwiwa ne tsakanin masana kimiyya daga Kenya da China, kuma ya ƙara wa iliminmu game da halayyar dawowa gida a cikin kwaɗayen da sauran dabbobi.
Kimiyyar Magunguna a Jinin Jiki na Maganin Rifampicin Mai Yawa ta Baki da kuma ta Jijiya a Marasa Lafiya da ke dauke da Kumburi a Kwanyar da ke faruwa sakamakon cutar Tuberculous:
Gwajin Sarrafawa da aka yi ta hanyar zaɓin raba
Hanyoyin maganin rifampicin da aka saka a jijiya masu yawa na iya inganta sakamako a cutar sankarau ta kwakwalwa, amma ba shi da amfani a wurare masu yawan kamuwa da cutar.

Mun yi zato cewa bayyanar rifampicin a cikin jinin zata kasance iri daya tsakanin shan maganin ta baki na 35 mg/kg na nauyin jiki da kuma allurar maganin ta jijiya na 20 mg/kg, wanda aka gabatar domin gwajin inganci a cutar meningitis ta cutar sankarau.
Mun gudanar da binciken sinadarai na jiki na ƙungiyar da aka raba ta hanyar raba-raba wanda aka saka a cikin gwajin asibiti na maganin rigakafi mai ƙarfi don meningitis na tarin fuka.
An dauki mahalarta masu dauke da cutar HIV wadanda ke dauke da cutar sankarau a kwakwalwa daga asibitoci a Afirka ta Kudu, aka raba su zuwa kungiyoyi uku na magungunan rifampicin:
na al'ada (ta baki 10 mg/kg),  babban kashi (ta baki 35 mg/kg), da kuma na jijiya (20 mg/kg).
An yi samfurin maganin magunguna sosai a rana ta 3.
An bayyana bayanan ta hanyar amfani da  binciken da ba shi da sashe, kuma an kwatanta abubuwan da aka fallasa ta hanyar ƙididdigar matsakaicin lissafi (GMRs).
Masu shiga guda arba’in da shida sun yi gwajin sinadarai (ma’aunin al’ada, n = 17; ma’aunin baki mai yawa, n = 15; na jijiya, n = 14).
Matsakaicin ƙididdigar CD4 shine kwayoyin 130/mm3 (kewayon tsakanin ƙididdiga [IQR], 66 zuwa 253 kwayoyin/mm3).

Darajojin matsakaicin yankin rifampicin karkashin laƙabin lokaci daga 0 zuwa 24 h (AUC0–24) sune 42.9mg · h/ml (95% amincewar tazara [CI], 24.5 zuwa 75.0mg ·h/ml) ga ma'aunin al'ada, 295.2mg · h/ml (95% CI, 189.9 zuwa 458.8mg · h/ml) ga babban ma'aunin baki, da 206.5mg · h/ml (95% CI, 154.6 zuwa 275.8mg · h/ml) ga allurar jini.

Darajar AUC0–24 GMR na rifampicin ita ce 1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 zuwa 2.21) kuma matsakaicin taro na magani a cikin jini (Cmax) GMR shi ne 0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 zuwa 1.23) ga allurar baki mai yawa dangane da allurar jini.
Yawancin plasma rifampicin AUC0–24 ya yi yawa bayan shan maganin baki na 35-mg/kg fiye da allurar jini a kashi 20-mg/kg a cikin 'yan kwanakin farko na maganin cutar tarin fuka (TB).
Sakamakon ya goyi bayan shan maganin rifampicin ta baki a gwajin cutar sankarau ta kwakwalwa na gaba.
Ana iya gwada magunguna masu ƙarfi a kan marasa lafiyar HIV da ke fama da kumburi na kwakwalwa (meningitis) sakamakon cutar sankarau.
Masu bincike sun tabbatar da cewa yana da kyau a fara gwada ko manyan magungunan rifampicin za su iya ceto marasa lafiyar HIV da ke fama da kumburi a kwakwalwa sakamakon cutar sankarau.
Har zuwa 3 daga cikin kowane marasa lafiyar HIV 5 da suka kamu da cutar sankarau ta meningitis suna mutuwa saboda wannan cuta, wacce ke kai wa tsarin jijiyoyin jiki hari.
Yawancin waɗanda suka tsira suna da lalacewar dindindin a tsarin juyayin su na tsakiya da muhimman jijiyoyin da ke fita daga kwakwalwa.
Wannan na iya shafar motsin zuciyarsu da motsinsu.
Wasu marasa lafiya suna fama da fitsari ko bugun jini, ko kuma wasu ɓangarori na fuska ko jikinsu sun kamu da nakasu.

Rifampicin, ƙarfin maganin rigakafi da ake amfani da shi wajen yakar cutar tarin fuka, ana yawan ba shi a matsayin kwayoyi domin a kashe ƙwayoyin cuta masu haifar da kumburi a kwakwalwa sakamakon cutar tarin fuka.
Marasa lafiya masu matsanancin rashin lafiya sau da yawa suna ganin kwayoyi suna da wahalar haɗiye.
Ana iya baiwa Rifampicin ta hanyar allurar jini (a cikin jijiyoyin jini) a matsayin ruwa.
Sai a saka allura a cikin jijiyar maraƙin don a iya sakin ruwan a jikinsa.
Har yanzu ba a yi gwaje-gwaje ba don gano yadda jikin mai haƙuri ke ɗaukar magani idan aka yi amfani da wannan hanya.
Maganin allurar jijiya yana buƙatar ƙarin kayan aiki, kwantar da mara lafiya a asibiti da kuma ma'aikacin kiwon lafiya mai horo wanda ya san yadda za a saka allurar jijiya yadda ya kamata.
Don haka, ba lallai bane zaɓi a yankunan da ba su da isassun albarkatu a duniya.
Likitoci sun riga sun sani cewa jikin ba ya daukar rifampicin sosai a cikin ruwan kwakwalwa, kashin baya da kwanyar kai, wanda shi ne inda kwayoyin cuta zasu iya ɓuya.
Shi ya sa ake buƙatar allurai masu yawa (na roba) don kashe dukkan ƙwayoyin cuta a jikin mai haƙuri yadda ya kamata.
Amma masu bincike ba su tabbata ba game da yawan maganin da zai iya zama inganci kuma lafiya.

Don haka masu bincike daga Afirka ta Kudu da Birtaniya sun so su gano, ta amfani da ƙananan marasa lafiya, idan yana da aminci a ba da allurai masu yawa na rifampicin ko dai a matsayin capsules ko kuma ta hanyar allurar jini, da kuma yadda jikinsu zai karɓi kowace sigar.
Wannan abu ne mai muhimmanci a sani kafin sauran masu bincike su fara gwaje-gwaje masu girma, ko kuma gwaji, inda suke shirin baiwa marasa lafiya da yawa allurai masu yawa na rifampicin.
An bai wa marasa lafiya 46 na Afirka ta Kudu masu kamuwa da cutar sankarau da kuma cutar sankarau ta kwakwalwa daya daga cikin nau'ikan maganin rifampicin guda uku.
Na farko shi ne maganin al'ada na kwayoyi da ake baiwa marasa lafiya a yanzu, wanda ya kai 10mg na rifampicin ga kowace kilogram da marasa lafiyar ke auna.
Wani rukuni kuma sun karɓi allunan maganin da ke ɗauke da maganin mai yawa, wato miligram 35 a kowace kilogram na nauyin mara lafiyar.
Kungiya ta uku ta karɓi maganin ta hanyar allurar jijiya, milligram 20 a kowace kilogram na nauyin mutum.
An ɗauki samfurin jinin marasa lafiya bayan kwana uku.
Bayan haka, masu binciken suka auna yawan rifampicin da ke cikin jinin jinin su (ruwan jini).
An sami ƙarin rifampicin a jikin marasa lafiya da suka karɓi allunan maganin da ke da yawa fiye da waɗanda suka karɓi maganin ta hanyar allurar jini ko kuma maganin da aka saba amfani da shi.
Matakin maganin a cikin jinin plasma iri ɗaya ne ga maganin ƙarfi da na allurar jijiya.
Wadannan matakan sun yi yawa fiye da lokacin da marasa lafiya suka karɓi maganin yau da kullun kawai.
A cewar masu binciken, wannan yana nuna cewa lafiyar marasa lafiya da ke fama da kumburi na kwakwalwa sakamakon cutar sankarau za ta inganta idan suka karɓi maganin rifampicin a ƙarin yawa.
Ba komai ne idan sun karɓi maganin ta hanyar allurai ko ta jijiya ba - abin da ya fi muhimmanci shine su karɓi maganin a  yawan gaske, domin jikinsu zai iya adana shi a  yawan gaske.
Sakamakon ya goyi bayan binciken da aka yi a Uganda da Indonesia.
Alal misali, ƙananan gwaje-gwaje guda biyu a Indonesia sun nuna cewa za a iya ceto rayukan marasa lafiya da yawa idan aka ba su maganin rifampicin mai yawa ko ta baki ko ta hanyar allura.
Amma abin takaici, masu bincike sun yi gargadin cewa mahalarta kaɗan ne suka shiga wannan binciken fiye da yadda suka yi fatan a farko, wanda hakan na iya gurgunta sakamakonsu.
An gudanar da binciken a Afirka ta Kudu.
Yana goyan bayan shirin gudanar da gwaje-gwaje don gwada ko ya dace a ba marasa lafiyar HIV masu cutar tarin fuka a kwakwalwa allurai masu yawa na rifampicin.
Ana fatan irin wannan magani zai ceci rayukan mutane da yawa a Afirka da sauran yankunan duniya inda tarin fuka mai shafar kwakwalwa matsala ce babba.
Shin haɗa takin zamani da biochar zai iya inganta ingancin ƙasa mai ƙarancin ƙarfi a bakin teku?
Rashin ƙarfin ƙasa babban cikas ne ga noman amfanin gona a yankin Afirka da ke kudu da Sahara.
Da dama daga cikin marubuta sun bayar da rahoton tasirin amfani da biochar da takin zamani akan ƙaruwar ƙasar.

A wannan bincike, an gudanar da gwajin kwanciyar hankali na kwanaki 30 a dakin gwaje-gwaje, inda aka yi amfani da samfurori gram 120 kowanne na ƙasa mai suna Haplic acrisol wadda aka ƙara mata biochar na dattin masara (cbio), biochar na ɓawon shinkafa (rbio), biochar na ɓawon kwayar kwakwa (coco300 da coco700) ko takin shanu (compost); da kuma biochar na ɓawon shinkafa da aka haɗa (rcocomp) ko biochar na dattin masara da aka haɗa (cococomp) a ƙimar 1% w/w na ƙari: ƙasa, bi da bi.

Sauran magunguna a cikin binciken sun haɗa da takin gonar kaji da aka haɗa da tarkacen masara ko tarkacen shinkafa (kashi 1% takin + kashi 1% tarkace: kashi 1% ƙasa w/w), bi da bi, don bincika tasirinsu akan numfashin ƙasa, ƙimar pH na ƙasa; carbon na ƙwayoyin cuta na ƙasa; ikon musayar ƙwayoyin; jimillar carbon na ƙasa, jimillar nitrogen da yawan nitrogen da ake samu.

Biochar da takin zamani idan aka yi amfani da su kaɗai ko tare, da kuma biochar da aka haɗa da takin zamani sun ƙara yawan pH na ƙasa daga raka'a 0.28–2.29 na pH idan aka kwatanta da na sarrafawa ba tare da gyara ba.

Numfashin tushe daga takin gida ko dattin shinkafa da aka hada, ko kuma kwalin hatsi na masara ko kuma kwalin da aka hada da takin gida sun fi na iko wanda bai gyaru ba, wanda ya yi kama da na maganin kwalin kawai.
Darajar TOC a takin gona na ƙafa ɗaya da kuma hadadden takin gona na hatsi da kuma biochar sun kai kashi 37% da 117% sama da na iko.

Haɗa amfani da biochar na ɓawon shinkafa da takin ƙasa ya ƙara yawan ƙwayoyin cuta masu amfani da kashi 132%, yayin da ƙara takin ƙasa kaɗai ya ƙara yawan ƙwayoyin cuta masu amfani da kashi 247%, idan aka kwatanta da na iko.

A ƙarshe, binciken ya nuna cewa amfani da takin ƙasa ko haɗa takin ƙasa da biochar, ko kuma biochar da aka haɗa ya inganta halayen ƙasa kamar yadda pH na ƙasa da MBC, kuma ya ƙarfafa ƙarfafa C na ƙasa ta hanyar haɓaka TOC da rage asarar C na ƙasa ta hanyar numfashi na tushe.
Biochar da takin gargajiya sun inganta ingancin ƙasa ga amfanin gona.

Wannan binciken ya bincika yadda biochar, abu mai dorewa, mai arzikin carbon wanda aka yi daga shara ta halittu, za a iya amfani da shi wajen inganta ingancin ƙasa a yankin Afirka da ke kudu da Sahara.
Nazarin ya gano cewa biochar yana inganta ingancin ƙasa a hanya ɗaya da hanyoyin madadin da suka fi tsada kuma ba su da sauƙin samu.
Daya daga cikin manyan matsaloli da ke fuskanta samar da amfanin gona a yankin Afirka da ke kudu da Sahara ita ce raguwar ƙarfin ƙasa.
Ingancin ƙasa mai kyau zai haifar da ingantattun amfanin gona, wanda zai rage talauci a yankunan karkara kuma ya dawo da lalacewar albarkatun kasa.
Bincike ya nuna cewa biochar, abu ne mai dorewa, mai arzikin carbon, wanda za a iya amfani da shi wajen inganta ƙasar noma.
Biochar kayan sharar ne da ake samu daga zafiyar sinadaran halitta, ko kuma biomass, a inda iskar oxygen ta yi kadan ko kuma babu.
An tabbatar da cewa biochar yana ƙara yawan saman ƙasa, yana ƙara samun ruwa da iska, kuma yana kunna ƙwayoyin cuta a cikin ƙasa.

Wannan binciken ya gwada tasirin biochar da takin gargajiya akan ingancin ƙasa ta amfani da alamomi kamar numfashin ƙasa, pH na ƙasa, yawan ƙwayoyin cuta, adadin carbon, da kuma adadin nitrogen da ke akwai.

Masu binciken sun samar da biochar na dattin masara, kwayar kwakwa da kuma huskar shinkafa ta amfani da pyrolysis, wanda ya ƙunshi zafiyar abubuwan halitta ba tare da iskar oxygen ba, a digiri 450 °C a cikin tanda da aka samar a gida.
Masu binciken sun samar da biochar na kwasfa kwakwa ta amfani da pyrolysis a 300 °C da kuma a 700 °C.
Sannan masu binciken suka kwantar da samfurin ƙasa da aka gauraya da biochar na tsawon kwanaki 30.

Kowace samfurin ta ƙunshi ƙasa ta musamman da aka shirya wacce ake kira Haplic acrisol, wacce aka gauraya da haɗin gwiwar biochar daban-daban da aka yi daga ƙwanƙwason masara, ɓawon shinkafa ko ɓawon kwakwa, da takin shanu.
Sauran samfurori sun ƙunshi cakuda ƙasa da takin shanu, tare da biochar na danyen shinkafa, da biochar na ƙwayar masara, bi da bi.
Kowanne samfurin ya ƙunshi kashi 1% na takin gida, kashi 1% ga kowanne biochar, domin masu binciken su iya bincika tasirin kowanne cakuda akan ingancin ƙasa.
Masu binciken sun gano cewa ƙara biochar da takin ƙasa a cikin ƙasa, ko dai daban-daban ko tare, ya ƙara darajar pH na ƙasa daga raka'a 0.28-2.29 na pH, idan aka kwatanta da ƙasa da ba a gauraya ba.
Karuwar pH yana nufin ƙasa ta yi ƙasa da tsami.

Nazarin ya gano cewa numfashi na tushe, ko mafi karancin adadin carbon dioxide da ƙasa ke fitarwa, ya karu lokacin da aka ƙara takin ƙasa kaɗai, ko kuma lokacin da aka gauraya takin ƙasa da ɓawon shinkafa, ko kuma biochar na ɗanɗanon masara ko kuma biochar ɗin da aka haɗa.

Samfurin ƙasa ya nuna ƙaruwar jimillar sinadarin carbon na kashi 37% lokacin da aka yi amfani da takin ƙasa kadai, kuma ƙaruwar kashi 117% lokacin da aka gauraya tarkacen hatsi na masara da takin ƙasa.

Yawan aikin ƙwayoyin cuta ya karu da kashi 132% inda ƙasa ta ƙunshi cakuda takin ƙasa da tarkacen shinkafa, idan aka kwatanta da ƙaruwar kashi 247% a cikin samfuran ƙasa waɗanda ke da takin ƙasa kawai.
Sakamakon wannan bincike ya nuna cewa za a iya rage tsantsan ƙasa ta amfani da biochar, wanda yake samuwa cikin sauƙi kuma a ƙimar arha.
Wannan ya bambanta da wata hanya ta daban wato, ƙara liming a ƙasa, wadda take da tsada kuma ba ta samuwa ga manoma kanana a yankin Afirka ta kudu da hamada ba.
Hanyar Kwayoyin Fibrin da ba ta dace ba a cutar Rheumatoid Arthritis da alaƙarta da cututtukan autoimmune, kumburi da thrombosis.
Hadarin kamuwa da cututtukan zuciya a marasa lafiyar RA yana da yawa sosai sakamakon kumburi na jiki.
Tasiri na dangantattun cututtukan autoimmune akan tsarin da kuma yiwuwar thrombosis na fibrin(ogen) har yanzu ba a sani ba.
Don haka, mun kwatanta hanyoyin aikin jijiyoyin jini, kumburi, haɗuwa da tsarin fibrin clot a cikin marasa lafiyar RA tare da masu kulawa lafiya kuma mun tantance dangantakar tsakanin ƙimar.
An tattara samfurin jini daga marasa lafiyar RA 30 da kuma masu lafiya 25 masu shekaru da jinsi iri ɗaya.
An auna matakan SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 da VCAM-1 ta amfani da hanyar gwaji ta immunoassay.
An tantance haɗuwar jinin jiki gaba ɗaya ta amfani da Thromboelastography.
An bincika hanyoyin haɗin fibrin da tsarin fiber ta amfani da na’urar duban ƙwayoyin halitta ta lantarki (Scanning Electron Microscopy).
An yi gano da ƙididdige citrullination a cikin clots na fibrin da aka samar ta amfani da antibody na Citrulline mai alama mai haske tare da Confocal Microscopy.
Matakan SAA, CRP da ICAM-1 sun yi yawa sosai a marasa cutar RA idan aka kwatanta da masu iko.
Ana rage ƙimar TEG da suka shafi fara haɗuwa (R da K), da gudun haɗa fibrin (α-Angle), da lokacin da aka kai mafi girman samar da thrombosis (TMRTG) a marasa cutar RA.
Bayanan da suka shafi ƙarfin jini (MA, MRTG, TGG) ba su bambanta da kyau a tsakanin RA da masu kulawa ba.
Samfurin ƙididdigewar hanyar lissafi ya nuna alaƙa mai ƙarfi tsakanin abubuwan da ke haifar da ciwon ƙwayar jini (CRP, SAA) da ma'aunin TEG fiye da alamun aikin ƙwayoyin jini.

Binciken ƙwayoyin cuta ya bayyana cewa hanyoyin haɗin fibrin masu kauri sun fi yawa a jikin marasa cutar RA idan aka kwatanta da masu iko [ matsakaici (ƙiyasin tsakanin ƙima) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm bi da bi, p<0.0001,  ƙimar yuwuwar=22.7).
An gano yankuna da dama na citrullinated a cikin tsarin kumburin fibrin a jikin marasa cutar RA, wanda ya yi kasa a samfurin iko (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
Marasa lafiya da ke fama da cutar RA mai aiki suna nuna halayyar haɗin jini wanda ya bambanta da abubuwan da aka samu a wasu cututtukan kumburi.

Sauya tsarin sinadarai ta hanyar citrullination da ke da alaƙa da cututtukan autoimmune na iya taka rawa wajen tantance tsarin fibrin da kuma yiwuwar haifar da haɗarin thrombotic mai girma a marasa lafiyar RA.
Tsaftar jini a marasa cutar sankarau na iya bayyana haɗarin kamuwa da bugun zuciya da na kwakwalwa.
Sabbin bincike kan cutar sanyi ta jiki (rheumatoid arthritis) sun ba da fahimtar abubuwan da ke haɗa wannan cuta da haɗarin kamuwa da cututtukan zuciya.
Kumburiyar jijiyoyi (RA) cuta ce mai ciwo da rauni, wacce ke da alaƙa da kumburi a jijiyoyi da kuma a duk jiki.
Tun da daɗewa, masana kimiyya sun san cewa marasa lafiya masu fama da cutar suna kuma da haɗarin kamuwa da cututtukan zuciya da jijiyoyin jini (CVD) har kashi 50% - kamar bugun jini ko bugun zuciya.
Muhimmin abu a cikin wannan haɗari shine tasirin kumburi akan tsarin haɗa jini.
A wannan bincike, masu bincike sun bincika wannan dangantaka, domin su gano ainihin dalilin da ya sa RA ke ƙara haɗarin cututtukan zuciya da jijiyoyin jini.
Musamman ma, masu binciken sun bincika tasirin kumburi da sauye-sauyen tsarin halitta a kan takamaiman furotin da ke da alaƙa da haɗa jini, wanda ake kira fibrin.

Waɗannan sinadaran sun bayyana a matsayin dogayen sarkar da ke samar da asalin “ƙulla” ga jinin da ya kafu, don haka duk wani canji ga fibrin kansu na iya haifar da tasirin sakamako ga tsarin kafuwar jini gaba ɗaya.
Masu bincike sun kwatanta samfuran jinin marasa cutar RA da samfuran jinin mutanen da ke da lafiya.
A kowace hanya, masu binciken suna neman “alamomi” a cikin jini waɗanda ke nuna kumburi, da kuma duk wata bambanci mara kyau a tsarin haɗin jini na al'ada wanda zai iya ƙara haɗarin CVD.
An kuma bincika jinin kanta ta hanyar microscope, domin gano duk wata canji a tsarin furotin na fibrin ɗinsu.

Masu binciken sun lura cewa jinin da ya kafu daga marasa lafiyar RA ya yi sauri wajen kafuwa fiye da na mutanen da ke da lafiya, kuma sandunan furotin da aka yi su da shi ma sun yi kauri sosai fiye da na al'ada.
Akwai kuma sauye-sauye a cikin amino acid ɗin da ke samar da furotin na fibrin, wanda ya sa suka kunna amsa ta rigakafi ta jiki, lamarin da ya haifar da ƙarin kumburi.

Masu bincike da dama sun lura da sauye-sauye a tsarin sinadarin amino acid na fibrin a haɗin gwiwar marasa cutar RA a da, amma wannan shi ne karo na farko da masu bincike suka ga wannan tasirin a jini.

Idan aka haɗa da sauran canje-canjen da aka gani a cikin jinin da ke manne, binciken na iya taimaka wa masana kimiyya su fahimci dangantakar da ke tsakanin RA da CVD sosai, da kuma yadda za a gano alamun farkon waɗannan cututtuka.
Ko da yake sakamakon farko waɗannan masu alƙawari ne, ya kamata a lura cewa girman samfurin don binciken ya yi ƙanƙanta.

Masu binciken sun kuma ambata cewa hanyar da suka yi amfani da ita wajen gano canjin amino acid a cikin furotin na iya kuma ɗaukar sakamako daga abubuwa marasa alaƙa, ma’ana za a buƙaci gwaje-gwaje na musamman da ke nufin fibrin don tabbatar da sakamakon a nan gaba.

A ƙarshe, fahimtar alaƙar rikitarwa tsakanin RA da ƙaruwar haɗarin cututtukan zuciya na iya inganta sakamakon ga marasa lafiyar RA yayin da muke koyo don gano da kuma magance waɗannan cututtukan yadda ya kamata.
Masu bincike daga Afirka ta Kudu, Denmark da Birtaniya sun shiga wannan bincike, wanda Hukumar Binciken Lafiya ta Afirka ta Kudu ta ba da kuɗi.
Hasashen yanayin teku ga masu amfani da tekun rairayin bakin teku - ra'ayoyi, amfani da karɓuwa
Wannan binciken na yanzu yana mai da niyya magance rashin jituwa tsakanin kimiyya da jama'a a matsayin rashin daidaito a samarwa da buƙatar bayanai wanda aka sani da gibin amfani.
A wannan yanayin, mun bincika muhimmancin bayanan yanayin teku (metocean) kamar yadda masu amfani a kasashe biyu na ƙasar Kudancin Duniya suka gani:
Afirka ta Kudu da kuma New Zealand.
A nan, ba wai kawai ana mai da hankali kan yadda ake ganin, amfani da kuma karɓar hasashen bala'o'i ba ne, amma ma'ana ana mai da hankali kan yadda ake amfani da hasashen yau da kullum.
An gudanar da binciken ne ta hanyar bincike, wanda aka tsara shi bisa tambayoyin bincike guda uku.
Tambayoyin binciken sun rufe batutuwa daga ƙira da dacewar kayan aikin hasashen, daidaito da dorewa, amfani, kima da martaba a ciki, da rashin tabbas game da sauyin yanayi (don ambaton kaɗan).
An raba tambayoyin bincike na kan layi sosai don ya haɗa da masu amfani da nishaɗi da na kasuwanci.
Nazarin ya mayar da hankali kan gano al'adun yanke shawara masu yuwuwa waɗanda ke shafar bukatun bayanan masu amfani da tekun gabar teku.

An yi amfani da  binciken yarda da al’adu (CCA) domin bincika fahimtar da aka raba da bambancin ra’ayoyi a tsakanin  rumbun masu amsa tambayoyi baki ɗaya, da kuma a cikin ƙungiyoyin ƙananan rumbun da ke da alaƙa da fannoni da ƙasashe.
Mun sami matakai daban-daban na amincewa a cikin ƙungiyar baki ɗaya (masu shiga daga ƙasashe biyu da dukkan sassan da aka haɗa) idan aka kwatanta da ƙungiyoyin masu amfani daban-daban.

Duk mahalarta da aka tattara sun nuna matsakaicin amincewar al'adu game da batutuwan da aka gabatar, amma tare da wasu bambance-bambance a ra'ayoyin a matakin ƙasa, wanda ke nuna yuwuwar al'adun ƙarƙashin ƙasa.

Idan aka yi nazari daban-daban kan ƙungiyoyin ƙasa da na fannoni, mun ga cewa matsaya ta al’adu mafi inganci tana cikin ƙungiyar masu amfani ta Afirka ta Kudu, tare da amincewa mai ƙarfi ba tare da la’akari da alaƙar fannoni ba.
Rukunin masu amfani da kasuwanci na New Zealand sun nuna rashin jituwa mafi muni da sauran ƙungiyoyin.
Mun tattauna tasirin abubuwan da muka samu akan muhimman abubuwa a karɓar sabis kuma saboda haka akan samar da hasashen da suka dace.
An kuma tattauna fifiko da dama na hasashen kimiyya a nan gaba, la'akari da tasirin canjin yanayi da ake sa ran.
Mun ƙarasa ne ta hanyar gabatar da tsarin tunani don haskaka muhimmiyar hulɗa tsakanin haɗin gwiwar samar da hasashen da daidaito/daidaito na kimiyya.
'Yan Afirka ta Kudu da kuma 'Yan New Zealand suna amincewa da hasashen yanayin teku.

'Yan Afirka ta Kudu da kuma 'Yan New Zealand da ke aiki da kuma zama a yankunan bakin teku suna dogaro da ayyukan hasashen yanayi masu sauƙin amfani, waɗanda kuma suke ba da hasashen daidai akai-akai.
Sassancin hasashen ƙasa da shafukan yanar gizo daban-daban na kasuwanci suna bayar da hasashen yadda yanayi zai kasance.
Suna ƙoƙarin zama daidai kuma masu amfani gwargwadon iyawa.
Ilmi da tunanin kimiyya mai yawa ne ke shiga irin wannan hasashen.

A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun zaɓi su kalli yadda mutane a Afirka ta Kudu da New Zealand ke amfani da ayyukan hasashen yanayi – duka ƙasashen suna da tsaffin bakin teku, amma suna da yawan jama'a da yanayin bakin teku daban-daban sosai.
Sun so su gano sau nawa ‘yan ƙauyen bakin teku ke amfani da ayyukan hasashen yanayi na ƙasa ko na kasuwanci, domin waɗanne dalilai da ko sun ga waɗannan ayyukan suna da amfani kuma abin dogaro.
Wadannan su ne muhimman abubuwa dangane da yadda sauyin yanayi na gaba zai iya shafar hasashen yanayi.
An amsa tambayoyin bincike na kan layi daga mutane 31 'yan Afirka ta Kudu da kuma mutane 126 'yan New Zealand.

Sun haɗa da mutanen da ke amfani da hasashen yanayi don ayyukan aiki (alāl misali masunta da kungiyoyin ceto da neman batattu), da kuma wasu da ke shiga cikin wasanni da ayyukan nishaɗi na ruwa kamar hawa igiyar ruwa, iyo ko kuma wasan ƙafa a ruwa.
Masu bincike sun tambaya game da sauƙin amfani da sabis ɗin hasashen yanayi da aka fi so, da kuma daidaito da ƙarfin hasashen sa.
Masu halarta sun lissafa abubuwan da suka sa ya zama da amfani kuma muhimmanci a gare su, kuma sun ce ko waɗannan zasu iya canzawa saboda sauyin yanayi.
Sun kuma buƙaci su ce ko sun amince da bayanin da hukumomin yanayin ƙasar su suka bayar, da kuma yadda suka ji game da hakan.
Yawancin ‘yan Afirka ta Kudu da suka shiga binciken masu shakatawa ne a tekun, ko kuma mutanen da ke taimakawa wajen aikin ceto da neman batattu ko kuma ayyukan bincike.
Yawancin 'yan New Zealand da suka amsa tambayoyin sun kalli hasashen yanayi saboda suna son zuwa kamun kifi, ko kuma hawa jirgin ruwa, ko kuma iyo a teku.
Masu halarta daga ƙasashen biyu sun amince da bayanin da hukumomin kula da yanayi na ƙasashensu suka bayar.
Sun fi son ayyukan hasashen da ke daidaito, daidaituwa, sauƙin amfani, kuma suna da fasalulluka da za a iya daidaita su da bukatunsu.
Masu shiga da suka yi amfani da wannan sabis ɗin don manufar aiki a zahiri sun ga cewa hasashen yanayin teku kusa da rairayin bakin teku ba su daidaita ba.
Bayanan wasu yankuna sun fi na wasu daidaito.
‘Yan Afirka ta Kudu sun fi ‘yan New Zealand amfani da ayyukan hasashen yanayi sau da yawa, kuma suna kallonsa aƙalla sau ɗaya a rana.
Ga kashi 9 daga cikin kowane masu amsa tambayoyi 10, tsarin hasashen da ya yi matuƙar kyau abu ne mai matuƙar muhimmanci.
Yawancin sun fi son sabis ɗin da ke ba da kallo na kwanaki uku zuwa bakwai a nan gaba.
Mutane da ke aiki a noma a ruwa ko kuma waɗanda suke buƙatar tsara shirye-shiryen gaggawa suna buƙatar hasashen dogon lokaci da na kakar.
Yawancin masu amfani sun yi imani da cewa saboda ƙaruwar sauyin yanayi, ayyukan hasashen za su yi amfani da ingantattun bayanai masu tushe a kimiyya a nan gaba don tabbatar da hasashen daidai.
Kaɗan daga cikin irin waɗannan nazarin an yi su a baya a ƙasashen ƙasashen Kudancin Duniya.
Masu binciken suna fatan sun samu isassun abubuwa daga mahalarta bisa ga tambayoyin da suka yi musu.
Wani rauni kuma shi ne cewa mutane da yawa daga New Zealand sun shiga binciken fiye da waɗanda suka fito daga Afirka ta Kudu.
Aikin nasu zai taimaka wa mutanen da ke aiki a wuraren hasashen yanayi wajen tsara samfurori masu kyau waɗanda ke ɗauke da buƙatun abokan cinikinsu a zuciya.
Za su iya yin gyare-gyare da sauye-sauye dangane da yadda abokan cinikinsu ke gamsuwa da dalilin amfani da shi.
Hanyar Haɗin Kai wajen Tantance Ingancin Tsarin Noma Mai Dacewa da Yanayin Sauyin Yanayi:
Al'amuran Lushoto
Tsarin noma mai dacewa da yanayin sauyin yanayi (CSA) na samun karbuwa a duk duniya.
Amma, ba ta bayyana abin da ya kamata a rufe a ƙarƙashin ginshiƙai uku— samarwa, juriya da ragewa.
Saboda haka, CSA ya ƙunshi ayyuka/fasahohin noma da dama, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama da wuya a fifita manufofin CSA.
Da farko dai, akwai rashin ka’idoji masu bayyane da kuma hanyoyin aiki don tantance ingancin tsare-tsaren da suka dace da yanayin yanayi.
Na biyu, bayanai kaɗan ne ke akwai game da tasirin hanyoyin magance matsalar da aka riga aka yi tallata su a matsayin CSA, musamman a ƙasashen da ke tasowa.
A ƙarshe, fifikon CSA bai ɗauki ra'ayoyin masu ruwa da tsaki ba don tabbatar da cewa hanyoyin magance matsalar sun dace, sun yi amfani kuma suna da damar amfani sosai.
A nan, mun bayyana sabon tsarin shiga tsakani na tantance ingancin noma na yanayi a cikin ayyukan manoma kanana.
Wannan ya gano alamomin matakin gonaki (da kuma hanyoyin tantancewa) na ginshiƙan tsaron abinci da daidaitawa na CSA.
Hakanan yana tallafawa ƙididdigar halartar nuna alama, yana ba da damar yin kimantawa na farko da na gaba na wayewa mai wayo game da yanayi.
An gwada tsarin a tsakanin manoma 72 waɗanda ke aiwatar da hanyoyin gyara yanayin noma daban-daban a ƙauyen Lushoto na Tanzania mai wayewa game da yanayi.

Musamman manoma sun yaba da ayyukan da suka inganta ƙarfin ƙasa da tsarinta, rage gudun ruwa a saman ƙasa, da kuma dawo da ƙasar da ta lalace saboda tasirin da suka haifar a kan amfanin gona da kuma noma a lokacin da ba a noma ba.
Yawancin lokaci, ayyukan CSA sun ƙara yawan samar da dabbobi, samar da abinci, cin abinci da kuma kudin shiga.
Hanyar aiki tana da sauƙin daidaitawa zuwa yankuna daban-daban da tsarin noma kuma tana ba da damar fifita shirye-shiryen gyara sosai.
Amma muna ba da shawara cewa a ɗauki CSA a matsayin ɓangare na tsarin sa ido, tantancewa da koyo.
Sabbin hanyoyin sa ido na taimaka wa masana kimiyya da manoma shiri don sauyin yanayi.
Masana kimiyya da ke aiki tare da manoma a Tanzaniya yanzu za su iya auna yadda sabbin hanyoyin noma ke aiki don rage illar sauyin yanayi.
Suna fatan hanyarsu za ta inganta tsaron abinci da kuma yawan amfanin gona ga manoma a wasu sassan duniya ma.
"Aikin gona mai wayo game da yanayi" abu ne Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ke ƙarfafawa domin taimaka wa manoma kanana su shirya don sauyin yanayi.
Manomi mai wayo game da yanayi yana daidaita da sauyin yanayin yanayi kuma yana iya ƙara tsaron abinci ta hanyar ƙara yawan amfanin gonakinsa.
Wannan matsala ce mai matukar muhimmanci ga manoma Tanzaniya, domin ƙasar na fama da karancin amfanin gona na amfanin hatsi masu muhimmanci sakamakon sauyin yanayi.

Amma, masu bincike sun ce yana da wuya a auna nasarar hanyoyin magance matsalar yanayi, kamar su hada shara, kuma manoma kansu ba koyaushe ake tuntubar su ba game da ko hanyoyin sun yi aiki kamar yadda aka nufa.
A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su tsara hanya don auna nasarar hanyoyin magance sauyin yanayi, tare da mayar da hankali musamman kan inganta tsaron abinci da daidaitawa.

Da farko, sun karanta wasu nazarin noma, sannan suka samar da jerin abubuwa guda biyu wadanda suka hada da abubuwa 14, ko “alamomin,” wadanda suka da muhimmanci wajen auna tsaron abinci da daidaitawa.

Sannan, suna aiki a gundumar Lushoto ta Tanzania, masu binciken sun hada kai da manoma na yankin da kuma masana a fannin noma da dama domin gano muhimman abubuwan da suka fi muhimmanci daga kowace jerin.
Manoman sun gano samar da abinci a matsayin alama mai matukar muhimmanci wajen tabbatar da tsaron abinci.
Wato, duk wani shiri da ya inganta amfanin gonakinsu yana da matukar muhimmanci.

A halin yanzu, game da bangaren daidaitawa, manoma musamman sun nuna sha’awa ga hanyoyin da suka taimaka musu wajen kare ƙasar gonakinsu, da kuma waɗanda suka inganta ilimi, ƙwarewa, da kudin shigansu.
Da zarar masu binciken sun tantance muhimmancin kowane alama, sun iya amfani da su wajen gwada ko hanyoyin magance matsalar shida a Lushoto sun yi nasara.
A kowace hanya, sun tambayi manoma na yankin, a kan sikelin 1-5, ko akwai karuwa a kowanne alama tun lokacin da aka fara shirin.
Wannan ya ba su damar ganin wacce daga cikin hanyoyin magance matsalar ta fi tasiri wajen samar da abinci da kuma daidaitawa.
Sun gano kawai 3 daga cikin hanyoyin magance matsalar 6 da ake amfani da su ne ke da tasiri na gaske.
Wadannan su ne iri-irin amfanin gona masu jure fari, da kuma samar da abinci mai kyau ga dabbobi.
Masu binciken sun ce hanyarsu ta sauƙaƙa tabbatar da cewa tsare-tsaren da za a yi nan gaba za su cika bukatun manoma a Lushoto da kuma manufofin noma mai dacewa da yanayin sauyin yanayi.
Sun ƙara da cewa zaɓin hanyoyin da suka dace yana kuma ƙara yuwuwar manoma za su ba maƙwabtansu shawara kan ayyuka masu kyau, ta haka ne za a yada ra’ayoyin noma masu dacewa da yanayin sauyin yanayi.

A mahangar fahimta, za a iya amfani da wannan hanya a wasu yankuna, kuma za ta taimaka wajen tabbatar da cewa dabarun noma masu dacewa da yanayin yanayi sun ɗauki yanayin yankin da ilimin manoma a la’akari ta hanyar bin diddigin ci gaba da tantancewa.
Ta haka ne, ƙoƙarin noma mai dacewa da yanayin zafi za su iya samun nasara sosai kuma su yadu, a Tanzaniya da kuma sauran ƙasashen Afirka.
Nazarin hadin gwiwa ne tsakanin masana kimiyya daga Kenya da Netherlands.
Kwayoyin cuta na Dabbobi masu kashin baya a matsayin nau'ikan da suka mamaye:  Hasashen da aka samu daga Afirka ta Kudu
Nazarin ƙwayoyin cuta masu cutarwa a matsayin nau'ikan tsire-tsire baƙi bai sami kulawa sosai ba a fannin ilimin yaduwar cututtuka.
Cututtukan da aka gabatar na iya haifar da mummunan tasiri ga halittu masu rai, tsarin halittu da suke zaune, da kuma tattalin arzikin da tsarin halittu ke tallafawa.

A wannan babi, mun yi amfani da nazarin lokuta na cututtukan da aka gabatar na dabbobi gida da na daji (kamar cutar kyama a karnuka, tarin fuka a shanu, da kuma cutar rinderpest) da kuma na mutane (kamar cutar kanjamau, sankarau da kuma cutar HIV) don nuna irin tasirin da wadannan kwayoyin cuta zasu iya haifarwa.
Tasiri mafi muni har zuwa yau shine na cutar rinderpest, wacce ta yi sanadiyyar mutuwar miliyoyin shanu, kuma ta kusan kawo ƙarshen wasu nau'ikan namun daji daga manyan sassan kudancin Afirka.
Wannan kuwa ya shafi tattalin arzikin yankin sosai, kuma ya haifar da manyan sauye-sauye a tsarin da kuma motsin halittu.

An kawar da cutar shanun Rinderpest a duniya baki daya, amma cutar kyama ta kare da kuma ta shanun naman sa har yanzu suna nan, kuma za a buƙaci ci gaba da taka tsantsan da kuma kulawa don shawo kansu.
Daga cikin cututtukan ɗan adam, an kuma kawar da cutar farauta a duniya baki ɗaya, amma tasirin cutar, wadda masu mulkin mallaka na Turai suka gabatar, ya yi barna sosai.

A farkon shekarun 1700, yawancin mutanen Khoekhoe na asali (har zuwa kashi 90% a wasu al'ummomi) sun mutu, wanda ya lalata al'adunsu da hanyar rayuwarsu, kuma ya bar 'yan tsirarun da suka tsira a matsayin ma'aikatan noma.
HIV, wanda aka gano shi a Afirka ta Kudu a shekarar 1982, ya kuma yi tasiri sosai, kuma maganin rigakafin cutar da ke akwai a yanzu yana kashe gwamnati Naira biliyan 66.4 a kowace shekara.
Mun kuma haɗa cutar West Nile da cutar mura ta Afirka a matsayin misalan cututtuka da suka samo asali daga Afirka, kuma har yanzu zasu iya zama masu lalata a duniya baki ɗaya.
Muna hasashen cewa sabbin cututtuka za su bullo yayin da mutane suke ci gaba da fadada yankunansu zuwa wuraren daji, da kuma yayin da yawan cinikayya ke ƙaruwa.
Abin da masana kimiyya suka sani game da ƙwayoyin cuta masu ƙanƙanta da ke haifar da cututtuka a Afirka ta Kudu

Wannan babi na littafi ya taƙaita bayanai na baya-bayan nan kan cututtuka kamar rinderpest, kugi, sankarau da HIV, wadanda dukkan su cututtukan ƙwayoyin cuta ne masu kutse (kwayoyin cuta, ƙwayoyin cuta da sauran ƙananan halittu da ake ɗauka ba na asali ba ne, ma'ana ba a samu su a wani yanayi ba).
Wadannan cututtuka duk suna shafar dabbobi da mutane a Afirka ta Kudu, kuma barkewar cututtukan a ƙarshe suna cutar da tattalin arzikin ƙasar.

A cikin filin bincike da ake kira ‘invasive science’, masana kimiyya suna nazari kan halittu masu rai waɗanda ke bunƙasa kuma ke haifar da illa bayan an gabatar da su a cikin sabbin yanayi inda ba a saba samun su ba.
Yawancin bincike sun mayar da hankali kan manyan “halittu masu mamaye” kamar tsire-tsire da dabbobi, amma masu mamaye ƙananan da ke haifar da cututtuka suna da muhimmanci.
A wannan babi, marubuta sun tattauna wasu cututtukan dabbobi da na mutane a Afirka ta Kudu da ke haifar da wadannan ƙwayoyin cuta da aka gabatar.
Sun ce cutar da ta fi hatsari ita ce cutar ‘rinderpest’, wadda aka gano a Afirka ta Kudu a shekara ta 1896.
Cututtukan shanun rinderpest cututtuka ce da ke shafar shanu da dabbobin daji, kuma ta'azzalalli ne.
Wannan kwayar cutar ɗaya ce ta haifar da sankarau a mutane.
Yawancin mutanen karkara sun fuskanci yunwa bayan barkewar cutar ta shekarar 1896, amma yanzu an kawar da cutar ta hanyar allurar riga-kafi.
Marubuta sun ce tsakanin shekarar 1772 zuwa 1861, karnuka da yawa a Afirka ta Kudu suna dauke da cutar kyama, duk da cewa mutane ba su san irin wannan cuta ba.

Zuwa shekara ta 1893, an riga an san cewa cutar kyama ce ta haifar da cutar kyama, don haka gwamnati ta yanke shawarar kashe karnukan da suka kamu da cutar tare da yi wa wadanda ba su kamu ba allurar rigakafi.
Amma, wannan bai kawar da cutar ba kuma har yanzu ta shafi dabbobi da yawa kamar su duikers, zakuna, karnukan daji, jakaloli da kuma raguna.
Marubuta sun ce a shekara ta 1928, yara biyu sun mutu sakamakon cizon zomo mai launin rawaya, wanda ya haifar da cutar kyama.
Tun daga lokacin, cutar kyama ta zama ruwan dare a Afirka ta Kudu.
Sun ce a shekara ta 1954,  yawancin 'yan Afirka ta Kudu kuma cutar sankarau ta shafa.
Lokacin da aka rubuta wannan babi, sankarar measles na kashe yara kusan 400 a kowace rana.
Sun ce sankarau na yaduwa sosai a wuraren da mutane da shanu ke zaune tare.
Marubuta sun kuma ambaci wata cuta mai suna cutar sanyin jiki ta shanu (BTB), wadda ƙwayoyin cuta ke haifarwa.
BTB ta kashe shanu, jaki, dabbobin daji, damisa, damisa, kudus, bera da kuma zakuna.
Sun ce an fara samun rahoton cutar BTB a wani shakatawa na ƙasa a Afirka ta Kudu a shekarar 1996.
Gwamnati ta shawo kan cutar ta hanyar kashe dabbobin Buffalo da suka kamu da cutar.
Marubuta sun ce wata cuta, wadda masu tafiya daga Turai suka shigo da ita Afirka ta Kudu, ta haifar da wata cuta mai suna ‘farauta’ a jikin mutane.
Cututtukan sun kashe sama da kashi 90% na mutanen Khoekhoe na yankin.
A ƙarshen cutar, al'adun Khoekhoe ta kusan ɓacewa.
Marubuta sun kuma bayar da rahoto game da cutar kamuwa da cutar rashin ƙarfin garkuwar jiki ta ɗan adam (HIV) wacce ta haifar da annobar cutar AIDS.
Masana kimiyya har yanzu suna tunanin cewa an fara yada cutar daga dabbobi zuwa ga mutane, a wata hanya da ake kira zoonosis.
An fara gano kwayar cutar a Afirka ta Kudu a shekarar 1982.
Sun ce, tun daga shekara ta 2019, babu riga-kafin cutar HIV ko magani.
Sun ƙarasa babi ta hanyar tattaunawa game da cutar kwayar cutar West Nile da cutar shanƙar naman alade ta Afirka, inda suka ce ta samo asali daga Afirka sannan ta yadu zuwa Turai da Amurka.
Kwayar cutar West Nile, sauro ne suka yada ta, kuma ta kashe tsuntsaye mafi yawa, amma kuma ta shafi dawakai da mutane.
Sun ce dabbobi irin su warthog da dabbobin daji masu kama da alade ne ke yada cutar mura ta naman alade ta Afirka.
Cututtukan sun shafi aladu, kuma sun shafi harkokin kasuwancin aladu matuka.
Marubuta sun ce sun tattauna kawai cututtukan da ƙwayoyin cuta da ƙwayoyin cuta ke haifarwa, don haka wannan babi ba cikakken bayanin dukkan ƙwayoyin cuta masu kutse ba ne.
Marubutan daga Afirka ta Kudu ne.
Hanya ta tiyata mai tushe a hujjoji don magance cyst na hakori.
Sarrafa cutar kankarin hakori mai suna odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) yadda ya kamata har yanzu yana da muhimmanci kuma yana haifar da rudani a rubuce-rubucen tiyata ta baki da fuska.
A halin yanzu, babu matsaya gama gari game da mafi dacewar maganin marasa lafiya da ke fama da cutar odontogenic keratocyst.
Daga cikin hanyoyin magani daban-daban da ake da su, babu wata hanya har zuwa yau da aka nuna cewa tana da ƙimar sake dawowa sifiri ko kusa da sifiri sai cirewa mai faɗi tare da gefuna masu tsabta.

Dangane da karancin shaidu masu tushe a fannin tiyata don kula da marasa lafiya masu cutar odontogenic keratocyst a rubuce-rubucen kimiyya, wannan bincike yana son gabatar da tsarin aikin tiyata, bisa ga sakamakon nazari, wanda abin fatan shi ne zai amfana wajen inganta maganin marasa lafiya masu wannan matsala.

Ta amfani da ma'auni kamar; girma, nau'in rauni (na farko ko na biyu), yanayin raunin (wanda ke tare da wasu alamun ko na daya), kasancewar ramuka a saman kwakwalwa, da kuma yawan sasanninta; muna gabatar da itacen shawara, domin taimakawa shirye-shiryen magani da kuma samun damar rage yiwuwar sake dawowa a kula da cutar kankarin hakori (odontogenic keratocyst).
Masu bincike sun ba da shawarwari kan hanyoyin ingantaccen maganin cututtukan haƙori.

Ta hanyar tattara sakamakon bincike da suka riga suka wanzu, masu bincike sun bayyana matakai masu bayyane waɗanda likitoci za su iya bi don gano da kuma kula da marasa lafiya da ke fama da cutar haƙori mai suna ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
OKC rauni ne, ko kuma ci gaba mara daidaito, a gemu na mutum.
Likitoci sun ga yanayin yana da wuya a warkar da shi, kuma marasa lafiya sau da yawa suna kamuwa da wata OKC ko da bayan samun nasarar magani.
Don haka, likitoci na neman hanyoyin da za su warkar da waɗannan raunukan haƙori yadda ya kamata kuma har abada.
A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun nemi matakan da likitoci ya kamata su ɗauka don gano da kuma magance cutar.
Sun yi haka ne ta hanyar bincika littattafan da suka riga suka wanzu, ko kuma rubutattun bincike na kimiyya, game da OKC.
Sun yi ƙoƙari musamman don neman bayani kan yadda likitoci suka kula da OKC a cikin shekara guda, kamar yadda aka ruwaito a cikin labarai 46 da suka samu.
Masu binciken sun gano cewa OKC ya fi yawa a maza fiye da mata, kuma yana iya shafar mutane har zuwa shekaru 90, duk da cewa ya fi yawa tsakanin shekaru 20 zuwa 30.
Cututtukan ya fi shafar ƙashin ƙasan hakori.
OKC yana fara daga cikin kashi, tare da kumburi a gemu kawai wanda zai bayyana daga baya.
Yawanci, marasa lafiya suna fama da ciwo kuma suna da wasu fitowar ruwa (ruwa, kamar ƙura, wanda ke fitowa daga rauni ko rauni), kuma tushen haƙoransu na iya motsawa daga wurin su.
Sun ba da shawara cewa likitoci su cire dukkanin cutar da haƙora masu kusa.

Bayan cirewa, ya kamata su shafa maganin da ake kira Carnoy’s solution, tare da nitrogen mai ruwa (ruwa mai sanyi sosai da ake amfani da shi wajen cire fatar da ta lalace da sauri) da kuma fluorouracil (wanda kuma aka sani da 5FU, maganin kansa na gama gari).
Bayan wannan magani, masu binciken sun ba da shawarar cewa mai haƙuri ya kamata ya yi duba lafiyar sa na tsawon shekaru 25.
Sun ce wannan maganin shine mafi kyau ga raunuka masu ƙanƙanta fiye da 'ya'yan itacen strawberries (3 cm).
Ga raunuka masu girma sama da santimita 3, masu binciken sun ba da shawarar ƙarin kulawa.
Sun ce likitoci ya kamata a farko su rage matsin lamba a cikin raunin kuma su cire ruwa, kuma su cire dukkanin nama da ke kewaye da haƙƙori.
Sai a yi maganin kashi da maganin Carnoy.
Sun ba da shawara cewa likitoci su duba wa wadannan marasa lafiya kowane wata biyu na tsawon shekaru biyu.
Idan mara lafiya yana da raunuka da yawa, likitoci kuma za su iya fitar da su ta amfani da kayan aikin asibiti na musamman.
Amma a zahiri, nazarin da aka yi bitar sun nuna cewa a mafi yawan lokuta, idan likitoci suka cire gurɓataccen fata kuma suka shafa 5FU, marasa lafiya ba za su sake kamuwa da OKC ba.
Duk da haka, sun yi gargadi cewa shaidar waɗannan magunguna ba koyaushe take ƙarfi ba, kuma sun sami ƙarancin littattafan kimiyya a kan wannan batu.
Masu binciken kuma ba su gudanar da gwaje-gwajen su ba don tabbatar da waɗannan shawarwari; maimakon haka, sun ƙoƙarta su tattara mafi kyawun zabin magani daga nazarin da sauran masu bincike suka yi.
Don haka, waɗannan masu bincike, da ke zaune a Najeriya da Amurka, sun ba da shawarar ƙarin bincike a ƙasashe daban-daban don gwada nasarar magungunan da aka ba da shawara a nan.
Sun kuma ƙarfafa likitoci su yi la’akari da sauran yanayin marasa lafiya yayin magani.
Rigakafin SARS-CoV-2 (2019-nCoV), MERS-CoV da SARSr-CoV na roba:  Nazari ta hanyar kwamfuta don gabatar da ɓangarorin da za a iya amfani da su a matsayin maganin rigakafi.

Kwayar cutar Coronavirus yawanci tana da takamaiman nau'in dabbobi a matsayin mai karɓa, dabbobi masu nono ko tsuntsaye dangane da nau'insu; duk da haka, waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta suna iya canza mai karɓa a wani lokaci sakamakon sauyi.
HCoV-229E daya ne daga cikin ƙwayoyin cuta shida na ɗan adam da suka haɗa da HCoV-NL63, HCoV-OC43, HCoV-HKU1, MERS-CoV da SARSr-CoV (SARSr-CoV-1 da SARS-CoV2), kuma ana samunsa a duk duniya.
MERS-CoV da SARS-CoV-2 na iya ci gaba da wanzuwa a saman abubuwa marasa rai kamar (ƙarfe, gilashi ko filastik har zuwa kwana tara) (Huang, C.-L, 2020).
Matakan rigakafin da maganin hydrochloroquine masu amfani ne, amma wata allurar riga-kafi mai inganci za ta iya zama dole don dakile yaduwar annobar cutar covid-19.
Makasudin nazarinmu shine gano ɓangarorin rigakafin cuta ta hanyoyin kere-kere na halittu.
Kayan Aiki da Hanyar Aiki

An samu cikakkun jerin ƙwayoyin halittar SARS-CoV-2 daga Tsarin Bayanan Korona ta Shekarar 2019 (2019nCoVR) da kuma ginshiƙai biyu,  cikin su akwai Cibiyar Ƙasa ta Bayanan Fasaha ta Halittu (NCBI)  Ƙungiyar Duniya kan Raba Duk Bayanan Cutar mura (GISAID) da kuma TAURAU/T-bio-infoserver don ilimin halittu ta yanar gizo.

Za mu gabatar da takaice game da asalin ƙwayar cuta, mu kwatanta bayanai masu tsari don gano yankin da aka kiyaye, mafi yawan yanki na furotin (wurin haɗuwa da manufa) da kuma tsarin haɗin kai don ƙirƙirar ƙwayar cuta mai yiwuwa (epitope) domin ƙirƙirar hanyoyin magani ga sabon ƙwayar cuta da aka gano a shekarar 2019-nCoV, nau'in SARSr-CoV da kuma MERS-CoV.
Abin mamaki, kwatanta jerin ƙwayoyin SARS-CoV-2 da wata cuta ta nuna cewa sinadaran da ke cikin abin da ke haɗa mai karɓa suna da yawa sosai tare da kashi 70% na kama.
Mun ba da kuɗi ga muhimman sinadaran amino guda biyar (L455, Y473, N479, F486, Q493) a yankin haɗin mai karɓa daga sinadaran kauri masu alhakin hulɗar tsakanin ƙwayar cuta da mai ɗauke da ita.
A cikin SARS-CoV- RBD akwai sinadaran (D480, da T487) da suka ba da damar kamuwa da cutar tsakanin nau'ikan dabbobin daban-daban.
Amma, a cikin SARS-CoV-2, ɗan ƙaramin gyara na wasu sinadarai na iya inganta hulɗa da mai karɓar kwayar halittar ɗan adam: L455, F486, Q493, da N501.
A cikin SARS-CoV,  sassan halittu guda biyu masu muhimmanci (479 da 487) an hade su da gane mai karɓar ACE2 na ɗan adam.
A cikin SARS-CoV-2, sinadarai masu daidaito da N479 sun daidaita da Q493 da T487 zuwa N501.

Mun gano jerin sunayen amino acid ɗin da aka kiyaye sosai a tsakanin ƙwayoyin cuta masu yawa da suka haɗa da 2019nCoV da sauran nau'ikan, an gano tsarin KRSFIEDLLFNKVTLADAGF ya kasance mai kyau sosai a wannan binciken kuma ya dace da yankin da ke kewaye da ɗaya daga cikin wuraren da aka sani na yanke na ƙwayar cutar SARS wanda ake ganin ana buƙata don kunna ƙwayar cuta don shiga cikin sel.

Wannan tsarin ɓangaren ƙwayar halitta da kuma bambancin da ke kewaye da shi sun zama tushen gabatar da takamaiman ɓangaren rigakafin ƙwayoyin halitta na roba; wannan gano na iya haifar da samun ɗan ƙaramin sinadari mai ƙarfi da kuma abubuwan da ke ɗaure.
Wannan binciken yana bayar da bayanai da damammaki don tabbatar da halittu.

Duk da haka, za a iya bayyana aikin a fannin ilimin halittu ta hanyar kwamfuta, kuma wasu za su iya kwaikwayensa sauƙi, duk da cewa sabbin bayanai da bincike kan cutar Covid-19 na fitowa da kuma ci gaba da sauri.
Masana kimiyya suna kwatanta cutar Covid-19 da wasu cututtukan da suka yi kama da ita domin taimakawa wajen nemo magungunan riga-kafi.

A watan Satumba na shekarar 2020, masana kimiyya a Mali sun kwatanta bayanan halittar ƙwayar cuta ta Covid-19 da ƙwayoyin cuta guda biyu masu alaƙa da juna don gano halaye da za su iya taimakawa wajen samar da allurar riga-kafi.
A lokacin, masana kimiyya har yanzu suna neman alluran rigakafi masu nasara na cutar Covid-19.
Sun so su gano sauye-sauye a cikin kwayar cutar Covid-19 da za ta iya taka rawa a kamuwa da cutar.
Don haka, masu binciken Mali sun kwatanta kwayar cutar Covid-19 (SARS-CoV-2) da wasu kwayoyin cutar coronavirus guda biyu da ke haifar da cututtuka ga mutane, wato MERS-CoV da SARS-CoV.
Daya daga cikin manyan manufofin binciken shine gano wurare na musamman a kan kwayar cutar Covid-19, da ake kira epitopes, wadanda tsarin garkuwar jikin dan adam zai iya gane su.
Gano su zai iya taimaka wa masana kimiyya wajen ƙirƙirar alluran riga-kafi masu inganci.
Masu binciken sun kuma kwatanta dukkan cututtukan ƙwayoyin cuta guda uku don ganin ko akwai kama-da-wane na kwayoyin halitta da zai iya taimakawa ƙarin ci gaban allurar riga-kafi.

Sun mayar da hankali kan tsarin kwayoyin halittar furotin mai kauri na ƙwayoyin cuta, wato furotin ɗin da ke da alhakin taimaka wa ƙwayoyin cuta na corona su manne, su kuma kamu da ƙwayoyin halittar ɗan adam.
Abin da masu binciken suka gano shi ne cewa sinadaran kwayoyin cuta guda uku duk suna da kama sosai, musamman sassan da ke hulɗa da kwayoyin halittar ɗan adam.
Abin da ya bambanta game da cutar Covid-19 shine akwai wasu ƙananan sauye-sauye a cikin furotin mai kauri wanda zai iya sa kwayar cutar ta zama mai inganci wajen ɗaure ga ƙwayoyin jikin ɗan adam.

Sakamakon wannan bincike na iya ba sauran masu bincike damar ƙirƙirar alluran riga-kafin cutar COVID-19 masu inganci ta hanyar taimaka musu wajen gano wurare a kan kwayar cutar da suke da kyau a matsayin abubuwan da za a iya amfani da su wajen yin alluran riga-kafin.
Haka kuma, nazarin ya bayar da sababbin bayanai game da kama-da-wane da bambance-bambancen halittar kwayar cutar Covid-19 da sauran kwayoyin cutar corona.

Masu binciken sun lura cewa bincike na gaba ya kamata ya mayar da hankali kan ko bambance-bambancen kwayoyin halitta a cikin kwayar cutar Covid-19 ya sa ta zama mai kamuwa da cuta kuma mai haɗari fiye da sauran kwayoyin cutar coronavirus.
Matsalolin Bugawa na Zuciya a Marasa Cutar COVID-19:  Bita na Tsarin Gaba ɗaya da kuma Nazari na Haɗa-haɗa
Ba za a iya watsi da rashin daidaito na bugun zuciya ba a marasa lafiya da ke dauke da cutar coronavirus 2019 (COVID-19) domin yana da tasiri sosai akan sakamakon.
Don haka, wannan binciken ya yi niyyar gina hujja mai karfi game da yawan kamuwa da cutar zuciya a marasa lafiyar COVID-19.
Mun gudanar da bincike na tsari don samun tushen bayanai/injina masu aminci,  ciki har da PubMed, Scopus,  laibreri na Cochrane da kuma Web of Science.
Bayan dubawa, an fitar da bayanai masu muhimmanci kuma an tattara abubuwan da suka faru daga nazarin da aka haɗa don yin nazari na meta-analysis.
A ƙarshe, an saka nazarin tara a cikin nazarin mu wanda ya ƙunshi marasa lafiya 1445.

Sakamakon binciken meta-analysis ya nuna cewa yawan kamuwa da rashin daidaito na bugun zuciya a marasa lafiyar COVID-19 shine kashi 19.7% tare da matakin amincewa na 95% (CI) wanda ke tsakanin kashi 11.7 zuwa 27.6%.
Haka kuma akwai bambancin da ya yi yawa (I2□=□94.67%).
Matsalolin bugun zuciya sun yi yawa sosai a marasa lafiyar da ke dauke da cutar COVID-19 kuma an ga haka a cikin kashi 19.7% daga cikinsu.
Kyakkyawan bin diddigin ta hanyar electrocardiogram tare da gano matsalolin bugun zuciya daidai da wuri yana da muhimmanci don ingantaccen kulawa da sakamako.
Masu fama da cutar Covid-19 da dama suna da bugawa mara kyau ta zuciya.
Masu bincike sun ce kimanin 1 cikin marasa lafiyar cutar Covid-19 5 suna fama da rashin daidaito na bugun zuciya, wanda kuma aka sani da bugun zuciya mara daidaito.

Domin yawan faruwarsa, sun ba da shawarar bin diddigin bugun zuciyar marasa lafiya ta amfani da na’ura mai suna electrocardiogram, domin likitoci su iya gano da kuma magance duk wata matsala ta bugun zuciya a matsayin farko.
Ko da yake cutar COVID-19 ta fi shafar huhu da tsarin numfashi, wasu bincike sun nuna cewa kuma za ta iya shafar zuciya.
Masu bincike sun so su sake duba bayanan marasa lafiya don ganin yadda matsalolin bugun zuciya suka yawaita a tsakanin marasa lafiyar cutar Covid-19 a shekarar 2020, kusa da farkon annobar duniya.

Sun gudanar da binciken hada-hada, wanda shine lokacin da masu bincike suka bincika nazarin daban-daban da yawa akan takamaiman batu don ƙoƙarin fitar da ƙarshe gaba ɗaya daga duk nazarin da aka haɗa.

Sun binciki nazarin da aka tantance ta hanyar takwarorinsu da sauran masu bincike suka yi a cikin manyan kundin bayanai, sannan suka fitar da duk wani bayani mai mahimmanci game da bugun zuciya mara kyau a marasa lafiyar cutar Covid-19.
A ƙarshe, sun haɗa nazarin 9 tare da bayanai game da marasa lafiya 1445.
Sun gano cewa an sami matsaloli na bugun zuciya a kashi 19.7% na marasa lafiyar da ke dauke da cutar Covid-19.
Duk da haka, sun yi gargadin cewa ƙarancin nazarin da suka yi amfani da shi na iya raunana ƙarshen sakamakon su.
Wasu daga cikin nazarin kuma ba su bayyana ainihin matsalar zuciya ba, kuma iyakokin kowane bincike na iya rikitar da iyakokin nazari na haɗin gwiwarsu.
Sun ba da shawara a nan gaba a binciki dalilin da ya sa yawancin marasa lafiya da ke dauke da cutar Covid-19 ke fama da rashin daidaito a bugun zuciya.
Marubutan wannan takarda sun fito daga Masar, amma marasa lafiyar da wannan bincike ya shafi sun fito daga China da Amurka.
Ra'ayoyin Sauran Masana Kan Hijira, Lafiyar Kwakwalwa da PTSD:
Tacewar Littattafan da suka dace
A wannan babi, mun gabatar da bita kan nazarin kimiyya da aka gudanar kan PTSD, lafiyar kwakwalwa da walwala na 'yan ƙaura.
Yawancin bincike sun nuna cewa matsalolin da suka gabata da kuma bayan hijira suna shafar lafiyar kwakwalwa da kuma PTSD na 'yan gudun hijira da kuma 'yan ci-rani.
A ƙasashen asali, fuskantar rauni da azabtarwa sun haifar da haɗari masu yawa ga lafiyar kwakwalwar 'yan ƙaura.
